title: Enterprise plan & features
content:
## Overview

The **Enterprise plan** is designed for organizations that need advanced security, compliance, dedicated infrastructure, and custom commercial terms. It includes all features from lower tiers plus single sign-on, tenant isolation, audit logging, and flexible credit pooling.

Enterprise is sold as an annual contract with custom pricing. Contact your account manager or [enterprise@emergent.com](mailto:enterprise@emergent.com) to discuss your requirements.

---

## Key features

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="SAML 2.0 SSO" icon="shield-check">
    Centralized authentication via Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, or any SAML 2.0 identity provider.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Dedicated infrastructure" icon="server">
    Isolated Kubernetes clusters for your organization—no resource sharing with other tenants.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Audit logs" icon="file-search">
    12-month retention of user activity, deployments, and admin actions. Export to CSV or JSON.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Flexible credit pooling" icon="piggy-bank">
    Organization-wide cumulative credit caps and shared billing across all teams.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

---

## Single sign-on (SAML 2.0)

Enterprise workspaces can enforce SSO with any SAML 2.0–compatible identity provider. Supported IdPs include:

- **Okta**
- **Azure Active Directory** (Microsoft Entra ID)
- **Google Workspace**
- Any other SAML 2.0 provider (OneLogin, PingIdentity, etc.)

Once SSO is configured, workspace members must authenticate through your IdP to access Emergent. You can optionally disable password-based login and enforce MFA policies at the IdP level.

<Note>
SSO configuration is handled by the Emergent support team during onboarding. You will provide your SAML metadata URL or XML file, and we will supply an Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL and Entity ID.
</Note>

---

## Dedicated Kubernetes clusters

Enterprise customers receive **tenant-isolated infrastructure**:

- Your workspaces, apps, and data run on dedicated Kubernetes nodes.
- No compute or memory sharing with other Emergent customers.
- Option to deploy in a specific cloud region (subject to availability).

This isolation ensures predictable performance, compliance with data-residency requirements, and reduced risk of noisy-neighbor effects.

<Info>
Dedicated clusters are provisioned during the onboarding process. Migration of existing workspaces to dedicated infrastructure is supported—contact your account manager for a migration plan.
</Info>

---

## Audit logs

Enterprise workspaces include a **12-month audit trail** of key events:

| Event type | Examples |
|------------|----------|
| **Authentication** | User login, SSO authentication, session expiry |
| **Workspace changes** | Member added/removed, role changed, workspace settings updated |
| **App lifecycle** | App created, deployed, preview launched, deleted |
| **Credit usage** | Credit purchase, recharge, cap adjustment |
| **Admin actions** | SSO config changed, audit log exported, custom domain added |

### Exporting logs

Workspace admins can export audit logs to **CSV** or **JSON** from the **Settings → Audit** panel. Logs are retained for 12 months; older entries are automatically archived.

<Tip>
For real-time SIEM integration, contact your account manager about webhook delivery of audit events (available as a custom add-on).
</Tip>

---

## Cumulative credit caps

Standard plans require each workspace to manage credits independently. Enterprise customers can configure **organization-wide credit pooling**:

- Set a single cumulative cap across all workspaces in your organization.
- Credits are drawn from a shared pool, simplifying budgeting and procurement.
- Auto-recharge policies apply at the organization level.

This is especially useful for large teams with many workspaces—finance can manage one budget line instead of tracking per-workspace balances.

<Note>
Credit pooling is opt-in. If you prefer isolated billing per workspace, you can keep the default workspace-level caps. See [Credit expiry & recharging](/credit-expiry-recharging) for details on how credits work.
</Note>

---

## Custom terms, DPA & SLA

Enterprise agreements include:

- **Custom MSA** tailored to your procurement and legal requirements.
- **Data Processing Addendum (DPA)** for GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations.
- **Service Level Agreement (SLA)** with uptime commitments and support response times.

Your account manager will work with your legal and procurement teams to finalize these documents before contract signature.

<Warning>
Enterprise features (SSO, dedicated infrastructure, audit logs) are activated only after the contract is fully executed and initial payment is received.
</Warning>

---

## Getting started

<Steps>
  <Step title="Contact sales">
    Email [enterprise@emergent.com](mailto:enterprise@emergent.com) or reach out to your account manager. Share your team size, compliance needs, and any specific infrastructure requirements.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Scoping & proposal">
    We'll schedule a call to understand your use case, map out SSO and infrastructure requirements, and provide a custom proposal with pricing.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Contract & onboarding">
    Legal review, DPA and SLA negotiation, contract signature. Our onboarding team will provision your dedicated cluster and configure SSO.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Migration & go-live">
    If you have existing workspaces, we'll migrate them to the new infrastructure. You can then enforce SSO and begin using audit logs and credit pooling.
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Info>
Typical onboarding takes 2–4 weeks from contract signature to production go-live, depending on infrastructure provisioning and SSO testing.
</Info>

---

## Frequently asked questions

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Can I trial Enterprise features before signing a contract?">
    Yes—we offer a 30-day proof-of-concept with SSO and audit logging enabled on a shared cluster. Contact your account manager to request a trial.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="What happens if I exceed my cumulative credit cap?">
    If auto-recharge is enabled, the system will top up your pool automatically. If auto-recharge is off, all workspaces in the organization will be paused until you add more credits.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Can I use multiple SSO providers (e.g., Okta and Azure AD)?">
    A single Enterprise workspace supports one SAML provider. If you need multiple IdPs (for example, after a merger), contact us about configuring separate workspaces or a custom federation setup.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Are dedicated clusters available in all regions?">
    We currently support dedicated deployments in **US East**, **EU West**, and **Asia Pacific**. Other regions may be available on request—contact your account manager.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How do I enforce SSO for all workspace members?">
    After SSO is configured, navigate to **Settings → Authentication** and toggle **Enforce SSO**. This disables password login and redirects all users to your IdP.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
